entities.summary: The Tiele, also transliterated as Chile, Dili, Zhile and Tele, who were also known by the Chinese exonym Gaoche or Gaoju, were a tribal confederation of Turkic ethnic origins living to the north of China proper and in Central Asia, emerging after the disintegration of the Xiongnu confederacy. Chinese sources associate them with the earlier Dingling.
